messages.author: d3e2e3c09c385ed8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps.io crashing [gray background]
parts: I was accessing my rds files from within the shiny application instead of having both my shiny applications and Rmd doc reference the same data file. Changing that solved the problem.
